productType.text: Multi-use eye and cheek primer balm

talkingPoints.text: long-lasting color, easy to blend and sets well.

benefits.text: Eye & Cheek Primer Balm is a multi-use eye and cheek primer balm that helps complete tone-pairing makeup with just one product. The soft, smooth balm blends easily, sets quickly on the skin and locks in color well, helping color last longer and minimising creasing, color spreading or patchiness through the day. The formula balances color hold and blendability, so it can be used on its own as an eye/cheek color or as a primer layer to boost color payoff and wear for makeup. The color can be layered flexibly and becomes more vivid with each layer, suited to quick 5-minute makeup, beginners, or days when you need a coordinated, neat eye–cheek look.

howToUse.text: Pick up an adequate amount with a finger or brush and blend lightly over the eye or cheek area. Can be used alone for color or as a primer layer before eyeshadow/blush to boost color hold.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim 100% smudge-proof, absolutely no creasing, all-day color wear in all conditions, or a full replacement for a dedicated eye primer unless there is a supporting claim.
